summary: Public local sources add capability, staffing, room-count and outpatient access information for RWJUH and Saint Peter’s, but do not provide order-level event data or turnaround distributions suitable for calibrating the required workflow stages. No verified downloadable/API dataset for local diagnostic timing was found within this bounded search. Treat these sources as capability evidence only; keep order-to-start, service, result and acknowledgement times unknown pending authorized institutional aggregates or event extracts.

sources.title: Laboratory Services — RWJ University Hospital New Brunswick
sources.geography: RWJUH New Brunswick and listed regional patient service locations; page describes routine lab services across facilities
sources.period: Current webpage; underlying operational period and revision date not stated
sources.grain: Service capability by laboratory location; no order, test, urgency, or time-series records
useful_fields: lab location names, including George Street and Rutgers RWJMS Clinical Academic Building in New Brunswick
routine tests described as having same-day turnaround
physician internet access to real-time lab results
observed_facts: The hospital page lists two New Brunswick laboratory service locations.
It describes same-day turnaround for routine tests but gives no test-level definitions, distributions, timestamps, sample size, censoring, or inpatient-versus-outpatient split.
sources.retrieval_next_step: For the bounded RWJUH New Brunswick lab slice, record the page and location names as capability evidence; request authorized, de-identified aggregate or event data from the hospital covering order, collection, receipt, result, and acknowledgement timestamps, test category, urgency, and cancellation/censor status. Do not translate the same-day claim into a local timing distribution.
limitations: No direct API or download dataset identified; this is a public informational page.
Same-day wording is not a quantified turnaround benchmark and does not define the start/end events.
No staffing, equipment, queue, urgency, or result-acknowledgement data.

sources.title: Radiology and Diagnostic Imaging — RWJUH New Brunswick
sources.geography: RWJUH New Brunswick campus and University Radiology at Robert Wood Johnson outpatient imaging center on Plum Street
sources.period: Current webpage; underlying operational period and revision date not stated
sources.grain: Capability by imaging modality and facility; no exam-level observations
observed_facts: The page lists the modalities above for the Plum Street outpatient imaging center and describes daily on-site radiologists.
It says hospital-based imaging capacity is intended to serve inpatients, but provides no volumes, schedules, queue lengths, turnaround or staffing counts.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Bound an initial RWJUH imaging workflow to one modality and setting (for example, inpatient CT). Use the page only to establish capability; request authorized event extracts containing order, protocol/ready, start, acquisition end, preliminary/final report, acknowledgement, urgency, location/equipment and censor/cancel state.
limitations: No public API/download or quantitative operational dataset identified.
Outpatient center capabilities cannot be assumed to describe inpatient equipment, staffing, queues, or processes.
No operational timings should be inferred from claims about reducing waits.

sources.title: Antenatal Testing — Saint Peter’s University Hospital
sources.geography: Saint Peter’s University Hospital Regional Perinatal Center, New Brunswick, Middlesex County, New Jersey
sources.period: Current webpage; page does not state the period for the annual volume figure
sources.grain: Annual patients and service-level staff/room counts for one specialty division; no individual encounter records
useful_fields: ultrasound capability including color flow Doppler and 3D/4D
listed diagnostic ultrasound and interventional procedures
observed_facts: The official page reports more than 16,000 annual patients, five physicians, eleven sonographers, and nine examination rooms for the antenatal testing division.
It lists diagnostic ultrasound services, procedures and counseling; it does not publish time-stamped order, service, result or acknowledgement records.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Use this as a bounded Saint Peter’s ultrasound capability and nominal resource-count slice. For calibration, request authorized aggregates or event records for one antenatal ultrasound workflow, stratified by urgency and procedure, with order, arrival/ready, start/end, result and review timestamps plus cancellations and right-censoring.
limitations: Annual patient count is not order volume or test volume; the webpage does not specify its reporting year or counting method.
Staff and rooms are division-level facts, not proof of simultaneous staffed capacity or availability by hour.
Specialty antenatal workflow is not representative of general hospital imaging or Middlesex County demand.

missing_inputs: No public, verified local order-level or interval dataset with stage timestamps, urgency, equipment/role, queues, and censoring was identified for either named hospital.
No quantitative timing distribution for order-to-start, service duration, result turnaround, or result acknowledgement.
No contemporaneous service hours, shift-level staffed capacity, modality utilization, queue length, or cancellation rates.
Saint Peter’s hospital-wide laboratory capability page and quantitative general imaging data remain unverified in this bounded research.
simulation_use: Add the verified public service and modality inventory as capability constraints. For Saint Peter’s antenatal ultrasound, encode only the reported division-level annual patient count, staffing and examination-room counts as sourced contextual inputs, not hourly capacity or order volume. Keep all workflow stage durations, urgency effects, queue dynamics and availability fractions unset or explicitly labeled scenario assumptions until institutionally authorized data is supplied. Preserve separate timestamps for order, ready/collection, service start/end, result, and acknowledgement, and represent cancellation and right-censoring explicitly.
limitations: This is candidate research, not dataset acquisition; no files or records were downloaded.
Public service pages can change and often omit effective dates, definitions and denominators.
Facility capabilities and staffing statements require scope and date verification with domain owners before operational use.
No local estimate should be inferred from the national/external sources already held by the project; none was needed for these capability findings.
